summary: Campspot: every RV type $35 base + $5 booking fee + tax (operator page $35/night, $170/week + tax); six RV sites sold online. Waterfront re-audit lead: the 30 Amp Spring Side RV Site (site 09, 25 ft) is now on sale on all four dates read - a back-in 'located right on the Natural Spring'. Google 4.7/610.
flags: PRICE GATE: $35 a night base on Campspot for every RV type (plus $5 booking fee and tax), matching the operator's '$35/night or $170/week + tax' - under US$50. Google Maps 4.7 over 610; RV Life 4* over 5.

WATERFRONT re-audit lead (stored not waterfront -> creekside for one site): the stored waterfront_evidence says the two 'Spring Side' RV types offered no site on six dates (Oct 2026-Jun 2027). On 2026-11-08 the '30 Amp Spring Side RV Site' type offered site 09 (25 ft, water/electric, back-in) on all four dates read (2026-11-17, 2026-11-21, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-03); a 23-ft rig fits. Campspot's text: 'This RV Site is located right on the Natural Spring that runs through the property. Enjoy the view of Tent Island and Shoal Creek.' On the park's own Campspot map site 09 sits on the east edge of the inner loop, between the loop road and the spring branch; on imagery the spring branch (a narrow run, creek class) passes under leaf-off trees ~15-30 m east of those pads, with no road between. All other RV sites (pull-throughs 12, back-ins 15/16/34) are set back as stored. Not changed per the brief.

Long-stay: the operator advertises $170 a week. The park's Campspot map draws ~26 RV pads, but only 6 are sold online; on imagery ~20 RVs occupy the two loops, so most pads look long-term. Five tests: (1) $35 - pass; (2) nightly on sale on Campspot with no approval - pass; (3) no minimum - pass; (4) 6 of ~26 RV pads sold nightly, over 1 in 10 - pass; (5) a family resort with a restaurant, tent island and cabanas, not a home community - pass. Keep.
Occupancy (Campspot, RV types): 2026-11-17 6 of 6 free; 2026-11-21 5 of 5 listed free; 2027-05-18 4 of 4; 2027-07-03 Spring Side 1 free, the pull-through and back-in types sold out.
